```{r, include = FALSE}
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"

```

```{r setup}
library(repulsiveDimples)
```

We initialize model parameters to be estimated:
```{r parameter_initialisation}
true_phi <- 0.8
true_rho <- 3
true_sigmasq <- 80
true_repulsionRange <- 0.4
kappa <- true_rho^2/(2*pi*true_phi*true_sigmasq)
mu <- 2*pi*true_phi*true_sigmasq/true_rho

true_params <- c(true_phi, true_rho, true_sigmasq, true_repulsionRange, kappa, mu)
setNames(true_params, c("phi", "rho", "sigmasq", "h", "kappa", "mu"))
rm(true_phi, true_rho, true_sigmasq, true_repulsionRange, kappa, mu)

sidelength <- 10
xlims <- c(0, sidelength)
ylims <- c(0, sidelength)
sim_win <- spatstat.geom::owin(xrange = c(0,sidelength),
                yrange = c(0,sidelength))
timescale <- 1 # We simulate independent realizations
```
